# splunkctl eventtypes

Event classification rules (eventtypes.conf) — read-only.

## eventtypes get

Show an eventtype's full stanza (search, tags, priority, color).

```text
splunkctl eventtypes get [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | App to resolve the eventtype in, when the same name exists in more than one app (default: current namespace). |

## eventtypes list

List eventtypes with their search and disabled state.

```text
splunkctl eventtypes list [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Only eventtypes in this app (default: current namespace, which may miss app-private eventtypes — pass --app to see them all). |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |
